profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineering that is looking to help business with development of products through the software life cycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·	Designed, developed, and maintained RESTful microservices in a fast-paced environment to meet customer requirements. 
·	Quickly develop, deploy, and debug cloud-based serverless applications using AWS to address dynamic needs of the clients. 
·	Troubleshoots pre-prod or demo problems related to software applications in tight deadlines. Resolves issues with software and responds to suggestions for improvements and enhancements.
·	Consults with project teams and end-user organizations identify application requirements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Added simulation capabilities to help with testing and training of our C2 system.
Led the effort to make JavaFx GUI elements be reusable and uniform widgets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·	Increased and maintained code coverage on previously written code from 20% to over 80% by writing unit, integration and GUI tests with the use of JUnit.   
·	Reduced Fortify (static analysis) findings from over 400 to less than 130 findings.
·	Ensured continued app performance when updating the underlying 3rd party map engine. 
·	Added capabilities to generically manage receiving and sending of messages from 3rd party sensors. Convert the messages to a 3rd party messages and forward it to another application. 
·	Participate in 3rd party hardware/software integration events, coordinate fixes with vendors and communicated the status with clients. 
·	Added features to the Android application that helped increase user’s visual awareness.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and coded application components according to multiple message specifications
	including JREAP, LINK-16, DIS, VXML, and CTCIN
	• Developed in C++, C# .NET software solutions based on existing and newly developed
	mission requirements
	• Contributed software engineering expertise in the development of products through the
	software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment
	• Designed, developed, tested, and maintained Composite Tacker and Classifier (CTCIN) link
	manager
	• Designed, developed, tested, and maintained Video XML (VXML) link manager
	• Actively participated in all team meetings to include all sprint kickoffs, sprint retrospect, and
	daily scrum standups
	• Worked with the IA team to quickly fix issues caused by new MacAfee HIPS policy
	• Deliver weekly NSITE builds using the build script to the Test team.
	• Maintained and modernized the Windows installer using Install Shield. Added features to Install Shield installation scripts for the application
	• Designed and developed JREAP (Joint Range Extension Application Protocol) Test Tool
	• Write release notes for new features when the product releases.
        • Provide Software estimates on new message formats.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Added simulation capabilities to help with testing and training of our C2 system.
· Led the effort to make JavaFx GUI elements be reusable and uniform widgets.

positions.description:

· Reduced Fortify (static analysis) findings from over 400 to less than 130 findings.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Designed, developed, and maintained the capability of receiving and parsing messages, storing them into a SQL database and visualize them to the users.
· Achieved customers security requirements by ensuring compliance with MacAfee HIPS policy.
· Successfully changed the installation directory of the application from root to Program Files folder.
